title: What was Iran's latest response to the United States?
text:
What was Iran's latest response to the United States?"

"In an interview with the IRIB News Agency, Foreign Minister Araqchi stated:"

"🔹Our response is clear. We have presented our proposal to the United States; if they are sincere about progress in negotiations and opening the Strait of Hormuz, they should abide by our conditions so that everything can be resolved.
